The first result seems relevant: retro_smarts_template: '[C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(=C)-C(=O)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2](-[C:3])-[C:4]'. This is forward: C-C(=C)-C(=O)-O... -> product with OH. That matches carbonyl-ene. So we can use template_id 1209837.

Now we need to apply this template to target to get precursors. Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id.
